responsibilities: Disassemble and repair hydraulic and drivetrain systems

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「环境苦 + 技能老化」——不补电控就掉队，活少时空转。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「工地环境 + 体力消耗大」——常在露天泥地钻车底，季节与项目影响活量；同时新型设备电子化程度高，纯机械经验在贬值，得补电路与诊断软件。自动化与远程诊断在吃部分常规排查。
risks: 工地环境艰苦
项目波动活量
纯机械经验贬值
诊断软件吃常规排查
体力消耗大

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管诊断仪多聪明，那根液压管漏不漏、那声异响对不对，最后还是机械师的手去摸、耳去听、扳手去紧——工地抢修这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but automation and remote account opening. Systems absorb standard applications, while people with strong command of rules are more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is automation combined with remote account opening. OCR and online applications absorb standard roles, but difficult cases and compliance still need people. Overall positions are also shrinking.
risks: Replacement by OCR
Online account opening
Role reductions
Repetitive tasks
Compliance pressure

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how smart systems become, clerks still have to inspect with their eyes, judge with their minds, and explain with their voices how to handle difficult cases, uphold compliance, and answer customers. People cannot be fully removed from account opening.

responsibilities: Conduct due diligence according to rules

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动化 + 远程开户」——标准开户被系统吃，有规则力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「自动化 + 远程开户」——OCR 与线上开户吃掉标准岗，但疑难与合规仍要人；同时岗位被压缩。
risks: OCR 替
线上开户
岗位压缩
重复作业
合规压力

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，疑难怎么判、合规怎么守、客户怎么答，最后还是文员的眼去核、脑去判、嘴去说——开户这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but CAD/CAM. Modeling is being taken over, while people who adjust and interpret results become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but CAD/CAM and CNC. Software absorbs modeling and toolpath generation, reducing manual patternmaking, but people remain essential for complex-part adjustment and interpretation.
risks: CAD replaces modeling
Automated toolpaths
Automatic process-sheet generation
Automatic inspection data entry
Simple parts move elsewhere

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how smart systems become, patternmakers' minds must decide how to adjust a complex surface and make process tradeoffs, their hands must refine it, and their eyes must measure a prototype's slight deviation. People cannot be removed completely from precision work.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是 CAD/CAM——建模被接管，会调试判读的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大的风险不是 AI，而是 CAD/CAM 与数控——建模和刀路被软件吃掉，手工制版在缩；但复杂件调试与判读仍要人。
risks: CAD 替建模
刀路自动化
工艺卡自动出
检测自动录
简单件外流

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪块复杂曲面怎么调、样件差几丝、工艺怎么取舍，最后还是制版工的脑去想、手去磨、眼去量——精度这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Fastest to be replaced by mechanization

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risks are policy and safety. Jobs shrink when mining rights tighten, while weak safety awareness causes accidents; both determine the occupation's ceiling.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but industry conditions and safety. Open-pit quarrying is heavily affected by environmental and mining policy, and jobs decline when mining rights tighten. The work environment also carries serious hazards, where even a small lapse in safety awareness can cause an accident.
risks: Tighter environmental and mining-rights policies expose jobs to industry cycles
Dust and noise in open-air work require health protection
Heavy labor and safety hazards create higher accident risk than office work
Mechanization replaces purely manual work
Remote mines have difficult living conditions

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can monitor equipment, optimize scheduling, and recognize fractures, but rock splitters always retain the judgment and safety responsibility for where to cut and whether material meets specifications.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「政策与安全」——矿权收紧时岗位缩水，安全意识差时出事故，两者都决定这行的天花板。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大的风险不是 AI，而是「行业属性和安全」：露天采石受环保和采矿政策影响大，矿权收紧时岗位减少；同时作业环境安全风险高，安全意识差一点就可能出事故。
risks: 环保与矿权政策收紧，岗位受行业周期影响
露天作业粉尘噪音，健康风险需防护
重体力与安全风险，事故概率高于办公室岗
机械化替代纯人力作业
偏远矿场生活条件艰苦

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能监控设备、优化调度、识别裂隙，但「这块石头从哪下刀、这块料合不合规格」——这个判断和安全责任，永远在劈裂工手里。

career_path_block.路径: Sales Representatives, Wholesale And Manufacturing, Except Technical And Scientific Products

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not rapid AI replacement but digitalization + flatter channels. Standard work is absorbed, and income depends on performance.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is digitalization + flatter channels. E-commerce and procurement platforms bypass intermediaries, while CRM and AI absorb leads and quotes. Key-account management and complex negotiations still depend on people.
risks: E-commerce bypasses intermediary sales
CRM absorbs lower-level lead work
Automated quotes replace standard orders
Flatter channels squeeze margins
Collection anxiety and heavy targets

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, sales representatives still use conversation, travel, and patient cultivation to build confidence in delivery promises, bargain at the last moment, and manage key accounts. People cannot be removed entirely from closing deals.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI 快替，而是「数字化 + 渠道扁平」——标准动作被吃，且看业绩吃饭。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「数字化 + 渠道扁平」——电商与采购平台绕开中间销售，CRM 与 AI 吃掉线索和报价；但大客户经营与复杂谈判仍离不开人。
risks: 电商绕开中间销售
CRM 吃低阶线索
自动报价替标准单
渠道扁平压利润
回款焦虑指标重

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，那句交期兜底的信任、最后一刻的砍价、大客户怎么经营，最后还是销售代表的嘴去谈、腿去跑、心去养——成交这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI itself but instructional support tools. Grading gets automated, while people who can guide and observe students become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI itself but instructional support tools. AI accelerates grading and teaching-material generation, but people remain necessary for classroom order and individual tutoring.
risks: AI replaces grading
Automated courseware generation
Attendance is automated
Automated exercise generation
Administrative roles are moving elsewhere

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent tools become, assistants still use their eyes to notice which child is distracted, their voices to explain where a student is stuck, and their hands to guide emotional reassurance. People cannot be fully removed from the classroom.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是教学辅助工具——批改被接管，会带人观察的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大的风险不是 AI，而是教学辅助工具——批改和课件生成被 AI 加速，但课堂秩序与个别辅导仍要人。
risks: 批改被 AI 替
课件自动生成
考勤自动化
练习自动出
事务岗外流

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多聪明，哪个孩子今天走神、哪道题卡住、怎么安抚情绪，最后还是助理的眼去观察、嘴去说、手去带——课堂这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Finance and B2B depend on trust

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risk in telemarketing is AI. It will first eliminate people who only recite scripts and pile up volume; moving into high-value sales makes you more valuable instead.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is pressure from both AI and compliance. AI calling robots handle many simple outbound calls, while industry enforcement limits nuisance-calling tactics. Salespeople who only recite scripts and rely on volume are being eliminated quickly, while those who can identify the right customers and close online still have room to grow.
risks: AI displacement: robots take over simple outbound calls
Income volatility: commission-based earnings are unstable
Emotional strain: frustration from rejection
Compliance risk: regulators restrict nuisance-calling tactics
Career longevity: high-volume, low-quality work is unsustainable

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI outbound calling can place ten thousand calls a day, but only a human salesperson can accurately judge what lies behind a customer's hesitation and whether to make one more attempt.

responsibilities: Explain by phone and close sales
Follow up with prospects and close

career_risk_cards.callout: 电销最大的风险就是 AI——它会先干掉「只会念话术、靠量堆」的那批人；往高价值销售走，反而更值钱。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险就是 AI 与合规双重挤压：AI 外呼机器人承接了大量简单外呼，行业整顿也限制了骚扰式打法；只会念话术、靠量堆业绩的销售被快速淘汰，会定位客户、能在线成单的人还有空间。
risks: AI 替代：简单外呼被机器人接管
收入波动：提成制收入不稳定
情绪消耗：被拒带来的挫败感
合规风险：骚扰式打法被监管
职业寿命：量大质低的路走不长

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 外呼能一天打一万通，但「客户那句犹豫里藏着什么、要不要再争取一下」——这个分寸，只有真人销售拿得准。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is simultaneous pressure from industry relocation and automation. Without learning new equipment, workers face replacement by both cheaper labor and more intelligent machines.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI, but long-term industry decline combined with job relocation. Textiles are labor-intensive, and capacity is moving toward automation and lower-cost regions. Traditional machine-tending roles are shrinking, while equipment maintenance and automated production-line roles increase.
risks: Industry contraction: Textile-capacity relocation and automation reduce jobs
Low income: Piece-rate earnings have a clear ceiling
Shift-work strain: Disrupted schedules and physical wear
Occupational illness risk: Noise, dust, and lint
Skill obsolescence: Manual machine tending is eliminated by new equipment

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can issue an alert before a yarn break, but people in the workshop still provide the hands that keep machines feeding smoothly and contain anomalies.

responsibilities: Operate and tend winding and twisting equipment
Handle broken ends and other operating anomalies
Sample yarn quality and maintain records
Assist with equipment repair and adjustment

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「行业转移 + 自动化」双线挤压——不学新设备，就会被更便宜的人工和更聪明的机器同时淘汰。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「行业长期下行 + 岗位转移」——纺织业劳动密集，产能向自动化与低成本地区转移，传统看车岗位在收缩，设备维护和自动化产线岗在增加。
risks: 行业收缩：纺织产能转移与自动化挤压岗位
收入偏低：计件收入天花板明显
倒班劳损：作息紊乱与身体消耗
职业病风险：噪声、粉尘与棉絮
技能过时：只会人工看车被新设备淘汰

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能在断头之前就发出预警，但把机器喂顺、把异常按下去的那双手，还是得车间里的人在。

responsibilities: 操作并看护卷绕捻线设备
skills: 络筒/捻线/拉伸设备操作
生产记录与交接班管理

career_path_block.说明: Many simple jobs with low premiums
Stable craftsmanship and a stable customer base

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risk in watch repair is not AI, but the long training period + a shrinking low-end market. Craftspeople who endure the solitude and master complex movements become increasingly scarce and valuable.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk to the occupation is not AI, but market changes and a skills gap. Smartwatches have reduced demand for low-end mechanical watches, while older watch repairers are retiring and too few young technicians are replacing them. Craftspeople who can repair complex movements are increasingly scarce.
risks: Skills gap: training takes a long time, and many people do not persist
Market disruption: smartwatches reduce low-end demand
Low starting income: apprentices earn little
Eyesight strain: prolonged close-range work
Dependence on premium clientele: location matters for independent shops

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can put every movement drawing into a database, but the tactile judgment of how much force to use when straightening a hairspring is the capital that makes watch-repair craftspeople more valuable with age.

responsibilities: Diagnose watch and clock faults and develop repair plans
Disassemble and clean movements and replace components
Assemble movements and adjust timekeeping accuracy
Record work orders and explain maintenance recommendations
skills: Use of tools and testing instruments
Customer communication and work order management

career_risk_cards.callout: 钟表维修最大的风险不是 AI，而是「学艺周期长 + 低端市场收缩」——熬得过寂寞、修得了复杂机芯的师傅，反而越来越稀缺、越来越值钱。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「市场与技能断层」：智能手表冲击了低端机械表需求，同时老一辈修表师傅退休，年轻技师断档，能修复杂机芯的师傅越来越稀缺。
risks: 技能断层：学成周期长，很多人熬不住
市场冲击：智能手表挤压低端需求
收入起步低：学徒期收入少
视力损耗：长期近距离用眼
高端客源依赖：独立开店看商圈

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能把所有机芯图纸装进数据库，但「这颗游丝该用多大力气摆正」——这份手感，是修表匠人越老越值钱的本钱。

responsibilities: 诊断钟表故障并制定维修方案
拆装清洗机芯并更换零件
记录工单并交代保养建议
